cong_thuc.ten: Mo Print Preview + gan nut nhanh
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Preview xem truoc phan trang truoc khi in. Gan len Quick Access de 1 click mo nhanh nhu Save/Undo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Click mui ten Quick Access > tich Print Preview > click bieu tuong kinh lup. Hoac Ctrl+P mo preview sheet Ke hoach KD.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Chon dich den: may giay that hoac may ao PDF de luu file dien tu gui mail.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Printer = Microsoft Print to PDF > Print > dat ten Bai19.pdf > Save ra Desktop.

cong_thuc.ten: Pham vi in: Selection / Active Sheets / Entire Workbook
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Active Sheets: sheet dang dung; Entire Workbook: ca file (vd 36 trang); Selection: chi vung dang boi den.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Boi den tieu de + 10 thu thuat > Print Selection chi in vung do. Muon in ca file 3 sheets chon Entire Workbook.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh in het; nhap from-to de in nhap, in test 1 trang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Entire Workbook 36 trang > Pages 1-10 chi in 10 trang dau de kiem tra.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bang rong nhieu cot chon Landscape cho vua; danh sach dai it cot chon Portrait.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bang Ke hoach rong chon Landscape; danh sach NV dai chon Portrait.

cong_thuc.ten: Show Margins keo le truc quan
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien duong le de keo bang chuot ngay tren preview, nhanh hon nhap so.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Show Margins > keo le tren xuong de tiet kiem 1 trang.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh inch (8.5x14") kho can theo chuan VN; doi cm de nhap 2cm trai/phai quen thuoc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Doi xong Page Setup hien cm; Custom Margins nhap 2cm.

cong_thuc.ten: Can le Margins + can giua trang (Center)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhap so le cu the; tich Center de bang nam giua giay doc + ngang, dep khi bang nho hon giay.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Margins 2cm + tich Center Horizontally + Vertically: bang Ke hoach nam giua trang A4.

cong_thuc.ten: Fit Sheet on One Page (co ve 1 trang)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Co toan bo ve dung 1 trang. Tien nhung du lieu dai se chu be ti, chi dung khi lech 1-2 cot/hang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Ke hoach KD 4 trang > Fit Sheet on One Page con 1/1 trang de gui sep xem tong.

cong_thuc.ten: Page Break Preview keo gom trang
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nhin thay vung Page1..4 va ran xanh. Keo ran ve bien tuong duong Fit thu cong, chu to hon Fit auto. Ctrl+Z hoan tac keo lo.
cong_thuc.vi_du: 4 vung xanh > keo duong doc sang phai + duong ngang xuong sat bien > Ctrl+P thay 1/1 trang.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Left/Center/Right la 3 o dau-cuoi trang. &Page tu tang so trang; ket hop text co dinh vd 'Ga Excel'. Xem truoc de can.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Custom Header Left='Ga Excel', Right=Insert Page Number. Footer Center='Luu hanh noi bo'. Preview thay ten trai + so trang phai.

cong_thuc.ten: Chen / xoa ngat trang Page Break
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Tach du lieu (trang 1) va chart (trang 2) rieng. Chon ca hang 17 thi ngat ngang; chon cot thi ngat doc.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Chon hang 17 > Insert Page Break -> Page1 du lieu, Page2 chart; Ctrl+P thay 1/2, 2/2.

cong_thuc.ten: Lap tieu de moi trang (Print Titles)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Bao cao 29 trang van thay hang tieu de Doanh thu/Khu vuc/Vung/Tinh o moi trang. Chon ca $1:$4 neu co tieu de lon + tieu de cot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Rows $4:$4 lap hang tieu de; Ctrl+P sang trang 2 van thay tieu de cot, khong phai doan.

cong_thuc.ten: Vung in Print Area (Set / Clear / Add)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Gioi han chi in vung quan trong (vd 10 thu thuat + tieu de). Clear de tro lai in het khi xong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Set vung 10 thu thuat -> Ctrl+P chi thay vung do; Clear de bo khi in bao cao khac.

cong_thuc.giai_thich: Mac dinh preview trang tinh khong ke o. Tich Print moi in ke o va tieu de dong (1,2,3) cot (A,B,C) de doi chieu.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Tich Gridlines Print -> ban in co ke o de cham cong; tich Headings de thay A,B,C giup huong dan nhap lieu.

cong_thuc.ten: An hien duong Page Break + Scaling canh bao
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Duong cham cham sau khi dung Break Preview gay kho chiu thi tat. Neu Fit be qua thi giam con 2 trang + giam le thay vi 1 trang.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Bo Show page breaks > OK; mo lai file khong con duong cham. Bao cao dai chuyen Fit 1x2 trang thay vi 1x1.

quiz.cau: Gan nut Print Preview o dau?
quiz.A: Quick Access Toolbar (mui ten tren cung)
quiz.giai_thich: 1 click mo preview nhanh nhu Save/Undo.

quiz.cau: Phim tat mo Print Preview/Print la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ctrl+P la chuan in/preview.

quiz.cau: Khong co may in giay thi chon gi de demo/luu?
quiz.giai_thich: PDF luu ra file thay vi giay.

quiz.cau: Mac dinh Settings in cai gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Chi in sheet hien tai.

quiz.cau: Muon in ca file 3 sheets (36 trang) chon gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Entire Workbook gom het sheets.

quiz.cau: Muon chi in vung dang boi den chon gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Chi in o dang chon; phai boi den truoc.

quiz.cau: In trang 1-10 nhap the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Gioi han from-to de in nhap/test.

quiz.cau: In rieng dung trang 7 nhap the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: From=To=7 in dung 1 trang.

quiz.cau: Bang rong nhieu cot nen chon huong gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Ngang vua bang, dep, tiet kiem cat trang.

quiz.cau: Hien duong le de keo bang chuot o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Hien cham den de keo le truc quan.

quiz.cau: Mac dinh don vi le trong Page Setup la gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Dau nhay kep la inch.

quiz.cau: Doi inch sang cm o dau?
quiz.D: File > Options > Advanced > Display > Ruler units: Centimeter
quiz.giai_thich: De can le chuan cm VN.

quiz.cau: Nhap so le cu the (2cm) o dau?
quiz.giai_thich: Nhap so + center tai day.

quiz.cau: De bang nho nam giua giay thi tich gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Can giua trai-phai va tren-duoi.

quiz.cau: Fit Sheet on One Page de lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: No Scaling > Fit Sheet; chi khi lech it.

quiz.cau: Rui ro lon nhat khi Fit bao cao 29 trang ve 1 trang?
quiz.giai_thich: Can nhan: chia 2 trang + giam le thay vi Fit mu.

quiz.cau: Xem vung ngat trang o che do nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Hien Page1-4 + duong xanh ran ngat.

quiz.cau: Keo gom 4 trang ve 1 trang trong Break Preview lam the nao?
quiz.B: Keo duong xanh sat bien phai + duoi
quiz.giai_thich: Keo ran xanh ve bien tuong duong Fit thu cong.

quiz.cau: Chen ngat trang ngang tai hang 17 de tach du lieu/chart lam the nao?
quiz.C: Chon hang 17 > Page Layout > Breaks > Insert Page Break
quiz.giai_thich: Chon ca hang roi Insert; kiem tra bang Break Preview.

quiz.cau: Lap lai hang tieu de moi trang in o dau?
quiz.D: Page Layout > Print Titles > Rows to repeat at top ($4:$4 hoac $1:$4)
quiz.giai_thich: 29 trang van thay tieu de Doanh thu/Khu vuc...

quiz.cau: File 29 trang muon trang 2 van thay tieu de cot thi set the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Lap dung hang tieu de, khong lap hang data.

quiz.cau: Gioi han chi in vung 10 thu thuat thi lam the nao?
quiz.B: Boi den vung > Print Area > Set Print Area
quiz.giai_thich: Set de chi in vung can; Clear khi xong.

quiz.cau: Xoa vung in de tro lai in binh thuong thi lam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Clear go bo gioi han vung in.

quiz.cau: Ban preview khong thay ke o du man hinh co luoi thi vi sao?
quiz.D: Vi chua tich Sheet Options > Gridlines Print (View chi la hien thi)
quiz.giai_thich: Man hinh thay chua chac in; phai tich Print.

quiz.cau: Muon ban in co ke o de cham cong thi tich gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Tich Print moi in ke o.

quiz.cau: Muon in ca ten cot A,B,C va so hang de huong dan thi tich gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Headings Print in tieu de dong/cot.

quiz.cau: Header Left 'Ga Excel' + so trang phai set o dau?
quiz.C: Page Setup > Header/Footer > Custom: Left text, Right &Page
quiz.giai_thich: &Page tu tang; go tay so 1 thi cac trang deu 1.

quiz.cau: Loi go tay so trang 1 thay vi &Page gay hau qua gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Phai dung &Page de tu tang.

quiz.cau: Duong cham cham ngat trang hien sau khi dung Break Preview thi tat o dau?
quiz.A: File > Options > Advanced > bo Show page breaks
quiz.giai_thich: Bo tich de an duong cham kho chiu.

quiz.cau: Keo le qua sat mep giay gay loi gi?
quiz.B: May in cat mat chu (ngoai vung printable)
quiz.giai_thich: Giu le toi thieu theo may in.

quiz.cau: Huong xu ly khi Fit ve 1 trang chu be qua?
quiz.C: Chia 2 trang + giam le + thu Portrait/Landscape thay vi co 1 trang
quiz.giai_thich: Uu tien doc duoc hon la gom 1 trang.

quiz.cau: De tach du lieu trang 1 va bieu do trang 2 thi kiem tra o dau sau khi Insert Break?
quiz.giai_thich: Preview xac nhan tach dung.

quiz.cau: Muon in thu 10 trang dau cua file 36 trang de kiem tra thi lam the nao?
quiz.giai_thich: Gioi han Pages de test truoc khi in het.

quiz.cau: Mo Print Titles bi mo (khong click duoc) thi nguyen nhan la gi?
quiz.B: Do mo tu Preview sai sheet; phai mo tu dung sheet can lap
quiz.giai_thich: Print Titles mo theo sheet hien tai.

quiz.cau: Them vung in moi ma khong mat vung cu thi dung gi?
quiz.C: Add to Print Area thay vi Set
quiz.giai_thich: Add giu vung cu, Set ghi de.

quiz.cau: Center Vertically quen tich thi bang nam o dau?
quiz.D: Dinh len dau trang thay vi giua doc
quiz.giai_thich: Can tich ca ngang + doc neu muon giua that.

quiz.cau: Undo keo duong xanh Break lo thi bam gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Hoan tac keo ran.

quiz.cau: Bao cao gui sep co ke o + tieu de lap + so trang thi can bat nhung gi?
quiz.giai_thich: Combo chuan cho bao cao nhieu trang.

quiz.cau: Luu bang ra PDF de gui mail thi thao tac dung la gi?
quiz.C: Printer Print to PDF > Print > dat ten > Save
quiz.giai_thich: PDF giu dinh dang, gon nhe.

quiz.cau: Kiem tra cuoi truoc khi bam Print la gi?
quiz.D: Ctrl+P xem preview: huong, le, fit, titles, area, header du chua
quiz.giai_thich: Preview 10 giay tranh in sai ton giay.
